description: Opaque cream ankle-length noble tunic with broad purple and gold woven floral-geometric borders around the neckline, vertical front strips, sleeve ends and hem. A rich plum-purple mantle drapes diagonally across the chest and over one shoulder, secured with a small round jeweled gold clasp. Wide ornate woven gold borders line the mantle. A brown leather waist belt has a large round gold clasp, smaller ornaments and a decorated long hanging strap. A gold ring with a dark purple stone is visible. Brown tall leather boots show below the tunic. No headgear, armor or weapon is present.
